schema: functions: name -> file, orig, size_orig, status (open, exact), kind, callers, note (by hand: an odd source form, a guessed name, dead code).

chkget.note: The local t is never used (its frame word is in the original).

access.note: WEGA: addresses are ADDR (segment, offset); -k: the kernel through /dev/kmem or a crash dump (kvseek, kpseek of kva.c/kpa.c), the physical memory through /dev/mem for addresses above 64K; ptrace/sptrace; lseek is not declared long (its result is an int).

chkmap.note: WEGA: the map of another segment is changed with a message ('?' map changing to segment); the stack segment (curseg) by stksiz/maxstor. The local i is never used.

within.note: WEGA: the segment must match; the bounds unsigned.

command.note: WEGA: > into a register writes the user block through ptrace/sptrace (uaddr from u_state, pc as segment and offset); ?* and /* checked against the symbol type (symtype); w/W write the long as two words.

item.note: WEGA: hex with % (0x too), the radix of $x/$d (ibase), <<seg>>offset, long names truncated to 7 with a message, no local names; the variables 0..2 and e are addresses (svar).

readsym.note: A name longer than 127 characters makes the loop endless (readchar is called only while there is room): a bug of the original, kept.

chkloc.note: WEGA: local names are not implemented; the function only says so.

stfind.note: WEGA: the search in the segment symbol table (struct segsym) for the symbol below an address, its own static fndseg/fnddiff (a copy of findsym in sym.c that returns the low word of the value). Source form: the last two tests grouped, ... ANDF (off-(base=p->ss_base)<... ANDF off>=base): off stays known in rr4 for the then part (ldl rr2,rr4), as the original.

frsize.note: WEGA: the frame size of a routine from its first instruction (jr: follow; dec r15,#n; sub r15,#nn; jp: follow). Source form: the segmented jp case ends `frsize(&b); return;` (the value from r2, no return temporary: the frame of the original is exactly its autos, 16 bytes; a return(frsize(&b)) in the block of b takes a temporary behind b); quirk in host/KNOWLEDGE.md.

exform.note: WEGA: formats as printed by the original (%%%04x, %06o, %6d ...), no I z Z, 'i' through printins; a long is masked to 31 bits; f and F convert the float with the EPU first. The long case as in Plexus (wx=itol(w,get(...))), the mask as a statement of its own. Open: the original stores the result of get in a temporary of the frame before itolws.I[0]=w (the shipped cc stores I[1] directly; with the arguments of itol in the other order only that store differs); no source form found.

nullfn.note: An empty function behind printesc (guessed name).

printc2.note: WEGA: printc with a second parameter: a pointer to a string pointer for sprintf (guessed name).

printf.note: printf and sprintf with the four double registers (fregs) as the printf of the oldlibc (printf/0_4.c).

doprnt.note: WEGA: the _doprnt of the oldlibc (ls, csh) with the floats (fpap, _fegcvt), %Y (_date), %T %t %M %m (tabs, adb's own), through printc2(c, sp) for printf and sprintf. Open: str = buf takes r3 in the shipped cc, r2 in the original (twice).

date.note: %Y of _doprnt: the date of ctime into the buffer (guessed name). The local n is never used.

printtrace.note: WEGA: $x and $d set the input base (ibase); $v lists the address variables and 42 longs from var (var has 42 entries); $e prints the value of each external data and bss symbol; no $a, $o. The locals narg..dynam, hi, argp, frame are never used (their frame words are in the original).

printfregs.note: WEGA: the eight EPU registers of u_fpstate (five words each and as double, through fpcvt.s). The parameter and the local k are not used.

printregs.note: The local a is never used (its frame words are in the original).

getreg.note: WEGA: register names r0..r14, sp, fcw, pc (two or three letters, fcw); returns the offset in regs[] or -1. Source form: the four tests grouped to the right, regnam=='r' ORF (regnam=='f' ORF (regnam=='s' ORF regnam=='p')): codgen gives the registers back at the end of each inner ||, so only the right grouping keeps regnam in rl7 for all four (host/OLDCC_LOG.md 2026-11-28).

runpcs.note: WEGA: ptrace or sptrace by segflg; bpwait(4,5); the breakpoint command runs with ':' replaced by '.'; samepc. Source form: the samepc case as an ELIF of its own (count++, execbkpt, ...): popt merges its tail with the then part, so the samepc test jumps to count++ as in the original.

setsym.note: WEGA: the s.out header, the segment table (struct segtab) and the segment symbol table (struct segsym, 300 entries, grown by 101); findsym(&dot) is called before the header is read; nsyms is divided by sizeof twice (pointer difference / 12): a bug of the original, kept.

setcor.note: WEGA: -k with /dev/kmem and /dev/mem or a crash dump (kdump), else the user block (0xa00 bytes, the segmented struct user: suser.h) and the registers from the state behind u_state.

chgdmap.note: For the core file the end of the map takes segtab[j].st_bss with the j of the loop (not i; j is not set when the program is not segmented): a bug of the original, kept.

findsym.note: WEGA (sym.c): the copy of stfind that returns &fnd (static ADDR: the segment and the distance) and reads the symbol into fsymbuf. Source form: the last two tests grouped, ... ANDF (off-(base=p->ss_base)<... ANDF off>=base): off stays known in rr4 for the then part (ldl rr2,rr4), as the original.

nextsym.note: WEGA: empty (the local symbols of Plexus are gone).

symread.note: WEGA: long names (a length byte with the high bit and more 14-byte entries).

symcopy.note: WEGA: the name of a symbol into symname, a long name from the following entries or from the file (guessed name). The locals i, j, k, l are never used.

fpcvt.note: fpcvt.s: an EPU load of the 80-bit register at r7 as a double and ret (guessed name; no C form gives this code).

acnvt.note: The _cnvt of the oldlibc (no _hexchar), under another name (_acnvt, guessed): the libc's cnvt is linked too.
